correctness.rationale: All n >= 2 for grid heights 2 and 3: the local domination/minimality condition is equivalent to a five-consecutive-column predicate, and the max-plus state recurrence is exact. The executable certificate verifies the period-four score-translation and zero second-difference identities on all 123 (height 2) or 1285 (height 3) reachable states; linearity then proves the infinite count and maximum-weight formulas. Direct independent brute enumeration tests the full vertex condition through eight columns.

originality.rationale: The distinct new component is exhaustive enumeration and classification of maximum-cardinality minimal dominating sets in both height-2 and height-3 open grids. The 2026 grid theorem gives their maximal size only; old enumerations count all cardinalities, and general uniqueness theory already covers the odd-area uniqueness implication but not the two-height nonunique count/classification. A previous result on cyclic prisms concerns a different graph and cannot be directly specialized. Historical priority is not independently certified.

value.rationale: An exact natural optimizer census for the first two nontrivial widths of the rectangular-grid family, motivated by the 2026 determination of Gamma, supplies complete optimizer structure instead of a cardinality upper bound. It distinguishes unique and parity-dependent 4/6-fold degeneracy and gives an exact all-order proof. The relevant 2017 tables count all minimal sets but leave this finer structural quantity unanswered. This is not merely a worked finite example.
